hero.title: IABuilder
hero.subtitle: AI in your terminal for daily development
hero.description: Work with any AI provider from your terminal. A practical tool that complements your workflow.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need for efficient development

terminal.title: Terminal-First
terminal.description: Works from any directory without opening special applications

providers.title: Multi-Provider
providers.description: Compatible with your existing API keys from any provider

tools.title: Practical Tools
tools.description: Read, edit, execute commands, and search through your code

context.title: Smart Context
context.description: Remembers your conversation and understands your project

install.title: Simple Installation
install.subtitle: Get started in minutes
install.finalText: That's it! You're ready to start using IABuilder.

providerSwitch.title: Switching Providers
providerSwitch.description: Once configured, you can easily switch between providers:
providerSwitch.note: Google Gemini works great for most development tasks. Switch to premium providers like GPT-4 or Claude for intensive/heavy usage.

why-local.title: Why Local Terminal AI?
why-local.subtitle: Take control of your AI development workflow

control.title: Full Control
control.description: Work with your files directly. No uploading code to web interfaces. Keep sensitive code private.

integration.title: Seamless Integration
integration.description: Works with your existing terminal workflow. Use alongside git, editors, and other dev tools.

speed.title: Faster Development
speed.description: No web latency. Direct API calls mean quicker responses and better productivity.

privacy.title: Privacy First
privacy.description: Your code stays on your machine. No risk of data leaks or code being stored on external servers.

offline.title: Offline Capable
offline.description: Continue working even without internet. Perfect for development on planes, remote areas, or unstable connections.

customization.title: Tailored Experience
customization.description: Customize your AI setup for your specific development style and project needs.

providers.title: Supported Providers
providers.subtitle: Free daily limits + premium options

google.name: Google Gemini
google.description: Best free option for professional development - Daily limits, no rate limits

groq.name: Groq
groq.description: Free daily tokens with rate limits

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.description: Free daily tokens with rate limits

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.description: Premium - GPT-4, GPT-3.5 (recommended for pro use)

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.description: Premium - Claude models (recommended for pro use)

providers.recommendation: Google Gemini works great for professional development with generous daily limits. For intensive/heavy usage, consider premium models like GPT-4 or Claude for unlimited access.

demo.title: Interactive Demo
demo.subtitle: Complete setup + development workflow
demo.description: This demo shows the complete IABuilder experience: from initial setup with Google Gemini (great for professional development) to building real features. For intensive/heavy usage, premium providers like GPT-4 or Claude offer unlimited access.

footer.description: IABuilder is a terminal tool that makes AI accessible without changing your workflow.
